news_items.headline: Corpay increases credit facilities by $1.3 billion, extends terms to 2031
news_items.summary: Corpay closed amendments to increase revolving credit facility by $925M to $3.7B and Term Loan A by $420M to $3.3B, both with new five-year terms extending to 2031. Expected to deliver interest expense savings.

news_items.headline: Cantor Fitzgerald reiterates Overweight on Corpay, citing cross-border strength
news_items.summary: Cantor Fitzgerald reiterated an Overweight rating, emphasizing Corpay's competitive advantage in cross-border payments and mid-market customer base.

news_items.headline: Loop Capital initiates Corpay with Buy rating, $406 PT
news_items.summary: Loop Capital initiated coverage on CPAY with a Buy rating and a $406 price target, citing corporate payments and cross-border growth.

news_items.headline: Corpay partners with BVNK to add stablecoin wallets
news_items.summary: Corpay announced a partnership with BVNK to integrate stablecoin wallet capability, extending its cross-border payments stack beyond traditional banking hours.

news_items.headline: Corpay highlights cross-border business in new investor presentation
news_items.summary: Company published a new investor deck focused on cross-border segment growth and the Alpha Group acquisition contribution.

news_items.headline: Corpay shareholders back board and auditor amid pay scrutiny
news_items.summary: At the annual meeting, shareholders re-elected the board and ratified the auditor despite scrutiny over executive compensation.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Cantor Fitzgerald reiterated Overweight this week. Loop Capital initiated Buy with $406 PT on 2026-05-19. Consensus 8 Buy / 4 Hold / 0 Sell. PT range $339-$440; 3-month avg PT $378.64.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 reported 2026-05-07: EPS $5.80 vs $5.50 consensus, revenue $1.26B vs $1.21B est (+25.4% YoY, 11% organic), shares +11.2% post-print (already priced in). FY26 guidance raised to $26.30-$27.10 EPS; Q2 guidance $6.45-$6.65 EPS, both above consensus. Street expects continued cross-border momentum (Alpha Group + Mastercard $300M), stablecoin optionality via BVNK, and capital deployment from expanded $3.7B revolver. Risk: Alpha/GPS/Paymerang integration cost.
